method: Tenant-scoped read-only aggregate of saved Commusoft-linked job records, published date fields and retained source-time classifications

sourceDocumentation.observedLimit: The account's actual nested completedOnDateTime values lack a zone even though the current public v2 documentation describes UTC ISO timestamps. The general documentation alone does not establish how to interpret these observed unzoned values.

businessDirection: Job progress and completion is the first scorecard priority; responsible-owner attention and handoff matter.
acceptedForDisplay: Captured job statuses can be shown with their source and freshness limits.
notAccepted: Completion duration or on-time result from unzoned values
A first-time-fix result without verified visit/return evidence
A published numerical job score without reviewed policy and source coverage
